copy.tagline: 抓取 Product Hunt 排行榜产品详情与创始人信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Product Hunt 获取产品数据和创始人联系方式。
copy.tagline_en: Scrape Product Hunt leaderboard products with details and maker info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need product data and maker contacts from Product Hunt.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以抓取 Product Hunt 每日、每周、每月或每年的排行榜产品数据，包括产品详情、创建者资料和网站联系信息。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Product Hunt、产品排行榜、抓取产品数据、获取创建者信息等关键词，或要求监控新产品发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我抓取今天 Product Hunt 的每日排行榜。
say.note: Claude 会提取当天排行榜上的产品列表。

say.text: 获取 Product Hunt 上排名第一的产品的创建者信息。
say.note: Claude 会访问创建者页面并提取资料。

say.text: 提取 Product Hunt 本周排行榜前五名产品的网站邮箱。
say.note: Claude 会访问产品网站并提取邮箱地址。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scrape Product Hunt daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly leaderboard launches with full product details, maker profiles, and website contact info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Product Hunt, leaderboard, scraping product data, getting maker info, or monitoring new product launches.

say_en.text: Scrape today's Product Hunt daily leaderboard.
say_en.note: Claude will extract the product list from today's leaderboard.

say_en.text: Get the maker info for the #1 product on Product Hunt.
say_en.note: Claude will visit the maker profile and extract details.

say_en.text: Extract website emails for the top 5 products on this week's Product Hunt leaderboard.
say_en.note: Claude will visit each product website and extract email addresses.
